name: mucker-monorepo
description: Mucker — Muck with your network, zero certs required. CDP-compatible Mock Engine for OkHttp.

scripts.build:dashboard: npm run build --workspace=dashboard && npm run copy:dashboard
scripts.copy:dashboard: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join('dashboard', 'dist', 'index.html'); const destDir = path.join('mucker', 'src', 'main', 'assets', 'mucker-web'); fs.mkdirSync(destDir, { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(src, path.join(destDir, 'index.html')); console.log('Copied dashboard single-bundle to Android assets!');"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:cli

author: Mucker Team
